atoms.text: Text A: The rainforests of the world are home to more species of plants and animals than any other ecosystem. The sloth is one of the animals that calls the rainforest home. Sloths eat mostly plants and insects. It’s a good thing they don’t need to hunt, because they’re really slow! They have long claws that help them grip trees and defend against attacks.

Text B: Capybaras live in the rainforest. Capybaras are the largest rodent in the world, about the size of a small dog! They love the water and spend a lot of their time swimming. Capybaras are herbivores, meaning they only eat plants. Capybaras are very social animals and live in families of up to twenty members.

instruction.text: Compare and contrast the texts about rainforest animals and select all the correct answers. There may be more than one correct answer.

hint.text: You may have to read the texts more than once to find the answers.
